hook: Your rights are on the line as the Supreme Court returns.

sections.voiceover: Your rights are on the line as the Supreme Court returns.
Thirty cases are scheduled for arguments through December 2026 in the nation's highest court. Which fundamental freedoms will change?
The Supreme Court also rejected appeals regarding felons' Second Amendment rights and COVID-19 vaccine mandates.

SCOTUSblog confirms the justices ignored requests to review those specific firearm restrictions this term. The Supreme Court docket lists 30 cases for arguments through December 2026 for the justices.
Track these thirty cases to understand your evolving constitutional rights.
